metadata.attribution: Tatoeba and its sentence contributors. Adapted into aggregate counts for CINQUE.
metadata.split: Deduplicate normalized token sequences; SHA256 first8 bytes big-endian modulo20: 0 TEST, 1 DEV, 2..19 TRAIN. Neither TEST nor DEV contributes any model count.
metadata.normalization: Same token_sequences as scripts/build_context.py; NFC lowercase; Italian letters; split apostrophes into tokens; sentence boundaries .!? and newline; 2..80 tokens, max48 letters per token.
metadata.model: Hierarchical interpolated absolute discounting with continuation prior mixed with external wordfreq. This is not full modified Kneser Ney: higher orders use raw counts, a single discount is used, and discarded count mass backs off.
metadata.changes: Retain full totals and distinct counts before pruning. Keep complete sentence-initial distribution. Other contexts retain up to24 pairs with count>=2. Prefer one-token contexts then highest-support contexts, capped at150000.
limitations: Translated example sentences, not representative private chats.
wordfreq is external pretraining and may overlap the evaluation corpus.
At most three preceding tokens, without whole-sentence semantic understanding.
